name: @playliquid/platform-leaderboard
description: PlayLiquid GameOS leaderboard authority service (PL-015). Ranked score submission over @playliquid/platform-contracts (AuthoritativeScoreRecord admission via validateScoreRecord, LeaderboardServicePolicy, rankLeaderboardEntries as THE ranking oracle, LeaderboardQueryRequest/LeaderboardPage read shapes) with evidence-keyed idempotency (E10: re-submission returns the recorded receipt, never a second mutation), windowed/seasonal boards with immutable frozen seasons, deterministic tie-breaking, stale-submission anti-gaming refusals (E8) and tenant isolation with least-privilege capability grants (R20). Pure domain: the service instance is the single mutable-state owner; persistence, time and grants live behind ports with in-memory fakes; no IO, no timers, no globals.
